User story: As a visitor opening /#compare, I want to land on the compare section immediately.
Expected behavior based on code: Opening http://localhost:5173/#compare should scroll the rendered page to section id=compare after the final React app mounts.
Initial result: location.hash was #compare but scrollY stayed 0 and #compare top was 5355px below viewport.
Fix status: Fixed in FinalSiteBridge: restored hash scrolling and repeated initial auto-scroll during early layout settlement.

User story: As a visitor in the compare section, I want to see the stage card, product detail card, and comparison panel together.
Expected behavior based on code: The #compare section should render product-stage-card, product-detail-card, and compare-panel.
Retest result: Pass: stage card, detail card, and compare panel rendered.

User story: As a visitor, I want the hero product card to clearly show the featured boiler context.
Expected behavior based on code: Stage card should show heading 'Надежное тепло для вашего дома' and image alt 'Navien Deluxe C16 на стене'.
Initial result: Heading and stage product frame were present.
Retest result: Pass: compare text includes headline and featured Navien model context.

User story: As a visitor, I want three reassurance points before comparing models.
Expected behavior based on code: Stage benefits should show 'Официальное оборудование', 'Сертифицированный монтаж', and 'Сервис в Алматы'.
Retest result: Pass: all three reassurance points present in #compare text.

User story: As a visitor, I want the featured model facts to be readable before I choose it.
Expected behavior based on code: Product detail card should show Navien Deluxe C16, type tags, description, 16 кВт, до 160 м², 91,2%, service in Алматы и область, price 659 900 ₸, and warranty text.
Initial result: Product title and specs rendered; text concatenation in probe was from DOM extraction, not a visual failure.
Retest result: Pass: product name, tags, specs, price, availability, and warranty text present.

User story: As a visitor, I want to save or mark the featured boiler by pressing the heart button.
Expected behavior based on code: The 'Добавить в избранное' button should toggle aria-pressed true/false and is-active class on click.
Initial result: Click left aria-pressed null and is-active false.
Fix status: Fixed in FinalSiteBridge: restored favorite click handler and aria-pressed/is-active state toggle.
Retest result: Pass: first click aria-pressed true and active; second click aria-pressed false and inactive.

User story: As a visitor, I want one detail tab to be visibly selected by default.
Expected behavior based on code: The first tab 'Обзор' should initialize as active when no tab is already active.
Initial result: All tabs initially had active=false and role/tabindex were null.
Fix status: Fixed in FinalSiteBridge: initialized detail tabs after React mount and mutations.
Retest result: Pass: Обзор active by default; other tabs inactive.

User story: As a visitor, I want to switch product detail tabs by clicking labels.
Expected behavior based on code: Clicking 'Характеристики' should make only that tab active.
Initial result: Clicking 'Характеристики' made it active and other tabs inactive.
Retest result: Pass: clicking Характеристики makes it the only active tab.

User story: As a keyboard user, I want all detail tabs to be reachable and activatable with Enter or Space.
Expected behavior based on code: All four tab labels should have role=button and tabindex=0; Enter/Space should switch active state.
Initial result: Span tabs had no role/tabindex before initialization; Tab traversal did not reach them in the tested sequence.
Fix status: Fixed in FinalSiteBridge: added role=button, tabindex=0, and Enter/Space activation for detail tabs.
Retest result: Pass: all 4 tabs have role=button and tabindex=0; Enter selects Комплектация; Space selects Отзывы.

User story: As a visitor, I want the 'Подобрать' button to take me to the request form.
Expected behavior based on code: Clicking 'Подобрать' should prevent dead-end behavior and navigate/scroll to #request.
Initial result: Button existed but final bundle lacks the dist inline click handler that scrolls to request.
Fix status: Fixed in FinalSiteBridge: restored Подобрать handler to update hash and scroll to request.
Retest result: Pass: click sets hash #request and request top is 19.8px from viewport top.

User story: As a visitor, I want to compare four models in the panel.
Expected behavior based on code: Compare panel should render exactly 4 models: Navien Deluxe C16, Rinnai RBK-158KTU, Baxi ECO Four 24 F, Ariston CLAS X 24 FF.
Initial result: Exactly 4 model cards rendered with expected names.
Retest result: Pass: exactly 4 model cards rendered with expected image alt names.

User story: As a visitor, I want each compared model to show power, area, efficiency, city, and country.
Expected behavior based on code: Each comparison row should show power, area, efficiency, 'Алматы', and country label.
Initial result: Each model row included specs and country labels.
Retest result: Pass: every model row includes кВт, м², %, and Алматы.

User story: As a visitor, I want each compared model to show a meaningful product image.
Expected behavior based on code: Each compare-panel article should include an image with alt text matching brand and model, and images should load without broken resource errors.
Test method: Chrome runtime probe plus network status
Initial result: Model images were present; only observed console 404 was unrelated favicon/not-found resource.
Retest result: Pass: all 4 model images have alt text and naturalWidth greater than 0; no failed image requests.

User story: As a mobile visitor, I want the compare section to remain readable without overlap.
Expected behavior based on code: At mobile width, stage card should stack, detail tabs should wrap to two columns, comparison rows should stack centered, and no horizontal overflow should appear.
Retest result: Pass: body scrollWidth 390 equals viewport, tabs wrap to 2 rows, compare cards are 338px wide and stacked.
